run_interactive_inference: run the interactive CLI to perform multimodal inference on image URLs and text input
run_construct_config: run construct_config to build an OmegaConf config from a dotlist of option strings
run_inference_forward: run inference.forward with an image URL and text dict to get a model response
review_interactive_function: review the interactive function that handles CLI argument parsing and inference loops
refactor_construct_config: refactor construct_config to support additional default config keys beyond checkpoint_path
